# Product Feedback Synthesizer Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Product Feedback Synthesizer Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 18 captured build checkpoints; 4 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 4 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved feedback environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded feedback documents, proposed Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams access and the intended channel; document blocked paths rather than bypass them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger; record who may build, test and later use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the feedback and review systems with approved identities and least-privilege references. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare product manager, engineering lead, product director and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser and the reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. | Customer or partner |
| Decision ownership | Have the product owner name who validates evidence and who owns prioritization and sequencing; keep real account names and feedback text out of workshop knowledge and public evidence. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Product business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Cross-channel feedback reconciliation and the inputs used to prioritize review candidates today. Show where channel reconciliation and isolated anecdotes cost time before agreeing customer success measures.

Fill your baseline record:

| Channel | Measurement period | Feedback volume | Reconciliation effort | Prioritization input | Review owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree feedback replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Product business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Product business owner | Approve feedback sources, audience and success measures; keep fictional votes, ARR weights and scores out of customer results. |
| Product trio and validation owners | Product, engineering, design, security, support and commercial owners validate candidates and retain prioritization and sequencing authority. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and four skills; remove web search, confirm the model and keep the owned agent in Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any production connection. |
| Feedback source and connection owners | Approve Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams access; record each connection identity and least-privilege reference and own access failures. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check PFS-01 through PFS-04, the boundary tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject missing identifiers, reshoot-required captures and other agents' Draft badges. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route product decisions back to the validation owners. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Feedback replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures have named agreement.
- [ ] The product owner records channel reconciliation effort and today's prioritization inputs before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/product-feedback-synthesizer/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The administrator's data policies cover the proposed Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams connectors, knowledge sources and intended channel; blocked routes stay blocked.
- [ ] The customer confirms authenticated audience and least-privilege access for customer feedback and account context.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/product-feedback-synthesizer/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/product-feedback-synthesizer/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/product-feedback-synthesizer/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/product-feedback-synthesizer/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Product Feedback Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_product-feedback-synthesizer-rules-and-guardrails.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_product-feedback-synthesizer-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: aibast_feature-requests_02
9. Add skill: aibast_feedback-summary_01
10. Add skill: aibast_roadmap-impact_04
11. Add skill: aibast_sentiment-analysis_03
12. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
13. Open a fresh Preview conversation
14. Pass PFS-01: Product Manager
15. Pass PFS-02: Engineering Lead
16. Pass PFS-03: Director of Product
17. Pass PFS-04: Product Manager
18. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: PFS-01, PFS-02, PFS-03, PFS-04. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, environment, model, inventory, cases and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `ProductFeedbackSynthesizerAgent` and returns `Total Feedback Entries`.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, four skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged PFS prompt passes once in a separate fresh Preview conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] The deterministic validator judges every case on its final response; annotated screenshots are checkpoints, not the machine gate.
- [ ] Any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills, model and case identifiers.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before exposing customer feedback or account context. Request only the scopes needed for approved feedback and review systems. Restrict the audience and test authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Feedback source and connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam — read:** Add approved read-only connector actions for the mapped records.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 6](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Do not browse or retrieve live data; answer only from the uploaded synthetic snapshot. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Say it is not in the supplied evidence; never invent an entry, request, metric or status.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Microsoft Teams Review Seam

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Feedback source and connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams Review Seam — write:** Keep briefs unsent; gate any Teams post behind an approved workflow (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams Review Seam:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams Review Seam:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams Review Seam:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Decline the commitment and the customer contact; present the evidence as a review candidate with named validation owners. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, ticket, notification or roadmap change succeeded.

### Step 3-3. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Feedback source and connection owners

Create dedicated connection references only for the approved feedback and review systems and verify least-privilege access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved connections preserve the reviewed input and output contract; no lookup or update is claimed without tool evidence.
- [ ] Every external action stays behind customer approval, least-privilege controls and an authorized human workflow.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test an approved deployment as intended product users and an unshared identity; a maker's access does not prove user access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; fictional votes, ARR weights and scores are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact assertions.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked feedback corpus | All four cases, PFS-01 through PFS-04, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, four skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. |
| Product authority boundary | Any roadmap commitment, ticket, notification, customer contact, account change or churn inference is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible positive anchor without a blocker or refusal; withhold reshoot-required captures. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Product business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Product business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved product audience and supported channels are tested before publication is confirmed.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review failed feedback sessions, unsupported inferences, connection errors and credit consumption in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
